p.s: There are a lot of advertisments in society, and I often see them.
I like seeing them, so I agree with the follwing statement that most advertisments make products seem much better than they really are.
First of all, it is often possible for most advertisments to make products seem much better than they really are because they often have a lot of coments and pictures.
For example, a lot of advertisements have many user 's coments, and they also have a lot of pictures.
The a lot of coments and pictures influence on readers.
If advertisement has nice coments and pictures, the goods is bought by a lot of people.
Second, the advertisements having a lot of pictures and coments can make reader happy.
For example, if you see advertisements which do not have advertisements, you maybe think the advertisements is very boring.
But, most advertisements have a lot of pictures and coments, so you can enjoy seeing the advertisements.
Therefore, you feel that most advertisements is very good, even if the advertisements is not better than they really are.
For these reasons, I think that I disagree with the following statement that most advertisements make products seem much better than they really are.
